notes.title: Wild Rumble Patch Notes 11/04!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello again, Rumblers![/b]

¡Welcome to the patch notes for the 11/04 release, in which we have implemented the Steam achievements!


STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS
--------------------------
Since a few days ago you could see the achievements on our Steam page... now you can unlock them!

There are a total of 21 achievements to unlock, you will have to play as a team, think well your strategies and be persistent if you want to get them all.


These are some of them, but if you want to see them all you can do it from your library or the store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/eccfe0010f42564b77b5fc3f7f57c07cf038ba87.png[/img]



BUGFIX
---------
- We have fixed a bug in the progression system where some Awakening could not be unlocked even if you completed a game with the unlock conditions.

----

That's all for now, what other achievements would you like to see? Join our discord channel and give us your feedback!

¡See you on the field!

- Mink Rafa

notes.title: Wild Rumble Patch Notes 17/03!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello again, Rumblers! [/b]
Welcome to the patch notes for the 17/03 release! We've got a bunch of new changes to share with you.... And some important news! Stick around until the end so you don't miss a thing. Let's get started:

[b]NEW IMPLEMENTATIONS[/b]
-----------------------------
- New popups and dialogs to help first time players understand some of the basic game mechanics.

- For Roguelike Mode: [b]added an initial Awakening[/b] (common) selection after selecting characters.

- [b]New visual element to identify completed characters.[/b] This will help players know which characters they have yet to complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/4f9699d01ce877115e6b6d7a71879209cb67fd44.png[/img]

- New transitions and visual effects in different Roguelike mode screens.

- Added victory and defeat sounds at the end of a match for both Roguelike and Quick Match modes.

- Added new dialogs when losing a game.


[b]AI[/b]
-----
- Improved pass decision making between allies.

- Improved general AI behavior in attacker state.

- Allied AI will only perform tackles when the opponent is close to the allied goalkeeper, thus increasing the passivity of the allied AI when defending so that the player has more resources available.

- Reduced the use of Poppy's wall by AI.

The general behavior of the AI as well as some other aspects have been improved - we think it feels much better! We look forward to continuing to receive feedback from you on areas for improvement <3


[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
-------------
- [b]Fixed a bug in the progression system[/b] where some Awakening could not be unlocked even after completing a game with the unlock conditions (checked with the reported Awakenings: Defensive Juggling, Inertia Sprinting and Ctrl + Z).

- Fixed the Awakening visual tooltip to change depending on player input.

- General localization fixes in buttons and visual elements.

We have also made some improvements to the game performance, optimizing some visual aspects.

-----

And now... A couple of important news!

[b]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]

- We are working on the different Steam achievements for Wild Rumble and they will be available in an upcoming update, later this month!

And it's already confirmed... 

[b]WILD RUMBLE FOR CONSOLES![/b]

- Hand in hand with [b]Dolores Entertainment[/b], we have already started working on the console versions of Wild Rumble. Xbox, Play and Nintendo Switch players, see you soon in the field!

-----

So that's it for this patch! What did you think? Which of these changes did you like the most? And the least? Let us know in the comments of the patch!

[b]See you on the field![/b]

- Mink Carles

notes.title: Wild Rumble Patch Notes 14/02
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Rumblers![/b]
Welcome to the 14/02 Patch Notes!

In this update we have fixed several bugs, implemented more gameplay options and balanced some aspects of the game. Take a look:


[b]BALANCE[/b]
-------------
- We balanced the Awakening "[i]Sturdy[/i]" (Your goalkeeper stays at 1 HP before dying). Before, it would trigger only for the first heart lost during the match. Now, it will be triggered for all the goalkeeper's hearts.

- The difficulty of the rival AI has been balanced. The AI's intelligence level will increase faster than before, however, we have reduced the amount of Awakenings they can have, as well as the stats of their characters. With this change we aim to make matches against the AI less frustrating and feel less unbalanced.


[b]IMPLEMENTATIONS[/b]
-----------------------
- Options menu has received some changes. Now, "[i]Instant Abilities[/i]" and "[i]Mouse Pass[/i]" can be found on the new Gameplay submenu.

- We added a new setting to enable/disable the AI AutoSwitch in the Gameplay submenu. This setting was always enabled by default. Disabling AutoSwitch means the system will not automatically change your controls to the AI-controlled character that just received the ball, instead, you'll always have to use the input to switch characters.

- We have added some small improvements to the credits screen.


[b]BUGFIXING[/b]
------------
- Fixed a bug that would make cursor invisible when playing cooperative even when one of the clients were using the keyboard and mouse controls.

- Fixed a bug that would make abilities to be directed in the wrong direction when playing 2 players coop if one of them was using keyboard and mouse controls.

-----

That's it! Over the next few weeks we will continue working with your feedback to add more improvements to Wild Rumble and fix bugs.

[b]See you on the field![/b]

- Mink Rafa

notes.title: Wild Rumble Patch notes 08/02
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Rumblers![/b]
Welcome to the Patch Notes for 08/02!

We heard you loud and clear, the game's AI needed improvements, and that's what we have been working on! That doesn't mean we're going to forget about it now. This is just the first patch to fix it, but we are going to keep working on AI, so expect more improvements in the upcoming weeks.
Aside from that, we have been fixing some general bugs. Take a look:

[b]AI[/b]
-------------
- AI will try to avoid Poppy's wall as well as other map hazards.

- Improved separation between allies when attacking (to avoid stacking up with your teammates).

- AI will react faster to your passes.

- In higher difficulties, rival AI will try to evade your tackles.

- Fixed a bug in which the AI controlling the ball wouldn't move.

[b]CO-OP[/b]
-------------
- Now, when loading a saved run in which co-op was enabled, the player will be asked if he wants to rejoin those players (Start for Gamepad and J for Keyboard to join).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/e80130d42c1dde016a7e07e38718a3b888deedbc.png[/img]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
-------------
- Minor Translation and Description fixes.

- Fixed Poppy teleport effect visual issue during animations.

- Improved Rumbling Shots trayectories and increased distance from which they are fired (this also fixes the issue some players were having where Rumbling Shots went out of bounds).

- Fixed button navigation issues in the E-SHOP if the Awakening List was opened while buying an Awakening.

- Fixed a bug where doing a Rumbling Shot when the goalie was already destroyed caused tackles and abilities to not work properly.

- General interface improvements.

-----

That's all for now! We hope those changes fix some frustrating behaviours that you have experienced throughout the week. You can expect more AI improvements, general bugfixes and difficulty balance in the next patches, so keep checking back for updates!

[b]See you on the field![/b]

- Mink Rafa

notes.title: Wild Rumble Patch Notes 04/02!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi Rumblers! [/b]
Welcome to the Patch Notes for 04/02! We have done some general bugfixing, made a change to Mutombo's gameplay and [b]added a new feature for Keyboard inputs[/b] that you might be interested in. Take a look:

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
-------------
- Fixed localization bug in roguelike loss dialogue.

- Fixed a bug that was showing to the player Awakening Upgrades rooms even when any of the Awakenings were upgradable, causing a lock in post match rewards screen.

- Fixed player's Directional Arrow visual fix during tutorial (in Tackle cooldown animation).

- Fixed a visual bug where Poppy's Ready quote was shown incorrectly after unlocking her.


[b]MENUS[/b]
-------------
- Added an Exit popup to leave to Main Menu from roguelike Room Selection screen (don't worry, your game will be saved).

- Tutorial can now be skipped by pressing the Start on Gamepad or Escape on Keyboard (cannot be skipped if it's your first time playing).


[b]INPUTS[/b]
-------------
Making accurate passes with the Keyboard is difficult, so we've enabled a new option that allows you to direct your passes to the mouse position.

This allows you to make passes in any direction without having to worry about your moving direction.

Check the option in [b]Settings -> General -> Mouse Pass (Keyboard)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/3ad4a374abaac61812865628b4e37ea80400d72e.png[/img]

Enabled: Your passes will be directed to mouse position.
Disabled: Your passes will be thrown where the directional arrow points.

We would love to get your feedback on this new setting!


[b]MUTOMBO[/b]
-------------
- Fixed a bug that was causing Mutombo's game end cinematic to crash.

- Mutombo's abilities now always have to be targeted, regardless of whether you have the Instant Cast Abilities setting activated. That's because Mutombo's abilities, unlike those of the others, can be cast at a range within range of the character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/14f2393446631e8650dc425065a0547455a27fbe.png[/img]

-----

That's all for now, we will keep working on updates based on your feedback! AI behavioural improvements will be coming later this week. Keep checking back for updates!

[b]See you on the field![/b]

- Mink Carles

notes.title: With 3 changes we managed to make the game 100x times more fun.
notes.notes:
Well, maybe not 100. I'm not very good at math. But that's not the point. Let's get down to business.

When we started working on Wild Rumble we had one thing clear: [b]We wanted teamplay to be as important as the individual skills of each player.[/b]

In this devlog I'm going to explain how we achieved that:

[h2][b]GOALKEEPERS WITH HEALTH BAR[/b][/h2].
When you shoot the ball, it will always be aimed at the goalkeeper, who will take damage and, consequently, its life bar will drop. 

You score a goal when the opponent goalkeeper's health bar reaches 0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/32ec906359645ed7f1656b0cc4e36ab1a276a5fd.png[/img]

[h2][b]CHARGING THE BALL WITH PASSES[/b][/h2]
When you pass the ball to your teammates, you will see that it takes on a color. The color represents the charge of the ball.

There are 3 possible charges: Green < Blue < Orange. Each one more powerful than the previous one.

The higher the charge, the more passes between allies necessary to get it, and the more damage it will cause to the goalkeeper.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/d74599538bb641231486f05fcca9185754aa92c1.png[/img]

[h2][b]MINI GAME TO SHOOT[/b][/h2]
To take advantage of the ball charge, the player must release the shoot button when the white vertical rectangle is positioned over the green zone.

If the player fails to synchronize this QTE, the damage that the goalkeeper will receive will be if the ball had no charge(minimal).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185246/388b56e07f4b95466d61195bd816607e00b1bd0e.png[/img]


And that's it! Don't forget to [b]add Wild Rumble to your Wishlist[/b] - that helps a lot!

[i]- Sergio[/i]
